question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To go to the devil

options.text: To mourn the death of a close friend
To be in an extremely and increasingly bad or ruinous condition

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"To go to the devil"** means to be in an extremely and increasingly bad or ruinous condition. (बेहद और लगातार खराब या बर्बादी की स्थिति में होना) • **Example:** If the company continues to lose money, it will eventually **go to the devil.** • **"To be in an extremely and increasingly bad or ruinous condition"** refers to a state where things are progressively getting worse. (बेहद और लगातार खराब या बर्बादी की स्थिति में होना) • **Example:** His financial situation has** gone to the devil **after he lost his job. • Hence, we can infer that the correct meaning of **'To go to the devil'** is **'To be in an extremely and increasingly bad or ruinous condition'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To mourn the death of a close friend** (किसी करीबी दोस्त की मृत्यु का शोक मनाना): • **Example:** She went into a deep mourning after her best friend passed away. • **Option 2: To switch allegiance** (निष्ठा बदलना): • **Example:** He decided to switch allegiance from one political party to another. • **Option 3: To curse someone** (किसी को शाप देना): • **Example:** The old woman was believed to have cursed the man who wronged her. 30:Tadb, The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
